description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Petroleum Geology topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: petroleum-geology

source.quote: Rocks are usually grouped into three main groups: igneous rocks, sedimentary rocks and metamorphic rocks

facts.claim: Igneous rocks form when magma or lava cools

source.quote: Igneous rocks are formed when magma cools in the Earth's crust

facts.claim: Sedimentary rocks are deposited in layers (strata, bedding)

source.quote: Sedimentary rocks are deposited in layers as strata, forming a structure called bedding

facts.claim: Law of superposition: lower layers are older

source.quote: he introduced the law of superposition, the principle of original horizontality

facts.claim: Source rocks are organic-rich sediments that generate hydrocarbons

source.quote: source rock is a sedimentary rock which has generated hydrocarbons or which has the potential to generate hydrocarbons
This thermal degradation or cracking releases shorter chain hydrocarbons from the original large and complex molecules occurring in the kerogen

facts.claim: Hydrocarbons accumulate in porous, permeable reservoir rock

source.quote: The reservoir is a porous and permeable lithological unit or set of units that holds the hydrocarbon reserves

facts.claim: Hydrocarbons are trapped beneath lower-permeability (cap) rock

source.quote: are trapped by overlying rock formations with lower permeability
Traps can be of two types: stratigraphic or structural

facts.claim: Anticlines and faults can trap hydrocarbons beneath impermeable rock

source.quote: If there is a layer of impermeable rock present in this dome shape, then water-insoluble hydrocarbons can accumulate at the crest

facts.claim: Folds are bent rock layers from permanent deformation

source.quote: a fold is a stack of originally planar surfaces, such as sedimentary strata, that are bent or curved

facts.claim: The lithosphere is broken into moving plates

source.quote: Earth's lithosphere, the rigid outer shell of the planet including the crust and upper mantle, is fractured into seven or eight major plates

facts.claim: Basins form by subsidence and fill with sediments

source.quote: They form when long-term subsidence creates a regional depression that provides accommodation space for accumulation of sediments

facts.claim: Seismic reflection images the subsurface from reflected waves (like sonar)

source.quote: Reflection seismology is similar to sonar and echolocation

facts.claim: A controlled source (dynamite, air gun, vibrator)

source.quote: The method requires a controlled seismic source of energy, such as dynamite or Tovex blast, a specialized air gun or a seismic vibrator

facts.claim: Gravity anomalies reveal density differences underground

source.quote: This gravity anomaly can reveal the presence of subsurface structures of unusual density
using a portable instrument called a gravimeter
